entries.2084ba666d9fe958: The company grants franchisees that operate franchise stores sub-licenses of know-how, trademarks and other rights, and receives royalties and other fees. Franchise revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥146,513 million, and the number of franchise stores was 2,320 (as of December 31, 2025).
entries.5ae13bde2d1a3a40: Franchise licenses (know-how, trademarks and other rights)
entries.6831b531c89c37be: A holding company whose subsidiary McDonald's Company (Japan) operates McDonald's hamburger restaurants in Japan; it runs company-operated restaurants and franchising.
entries.72b497346dde3b51: McDonald's Japan Co., Ltd. operates stores under the company-operated store model. Company-operated store revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥270,089 million, and the number of company-operated stores was 705 (as of December 31, 2025).
entries.852df44105d41786: This is the group's sole business. As a holding company, the company formulates and executes the group's consolidated management strategy and conducts real estate leasing; its 100%-owned subsidiary McDonald's Japan Co., Ltd. operates stores under the company-operated store model and expands stores under the franchise model. The company pays royalties to McDonald's Corporation of the United States for licenses it grants, and it grants sub-licenses of know-how and trademarks to domestic franchisees, from which it receives royalties. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥416,602 million.
